meta.note: DESCRIPTIVE co-occurrence, NOT causal synergy. The score is the shared-minutes-weighted sum of each player's OWN net rating, averaged over the games the two were rostered together. It reflects how much net value two players carried while sharing a roster — it does not isolate how they interact (no lineup +/-, on/off, or fit term). High score = two good players who logged minutes together; low = weak/low-minute pairs.
